value: Mean depth over the MUC1 VNTR: 70x. At that depth (between 50x and 100x) VNtyper found the known variant in 95 of 108 runs (88%), in VNtyper 2.0.47's downsampling of 42 confirmed positive GRCh38 exomes (repeated runs, not independent tests).
VNtyper calls no MUC1 VNTR frameshift.

A negative here lowers the chance of the frameshifts VNtyper looks for; it does not rule ADTKD-MUC1 out. A family history of kidney failure with gout or a bland urine sediment still deserves a clinical test (SNaPshot for dupC).
